channel.title: Orchard Valley Gazette
channel.description: News from the valley, on your computer.

item.title: User Group Meets Thursday at the Library
item.description:
The Orchard Valley Apple II Users' Group will meet this Thursday at 7:30 in the community room of the public library. Members are asked to bring blank disks for the monthly disk swap.

This month's program is a demonstration of a 1200-baud modem, followed by questions and answers on printers, word processing and the new 3.5-inch drives.

Visitors are welcome. Refreshments will be served.

item.title: Computer Store Gets Its First 3.5-Inch Drives
item.description:
The computer store on Main Street received its first shipment of 3.5-inch disk drives this week. Each disk holds 800K, more than five times as much as a 5.25-inch floppy.

"People keep asking whether their old disks will still work," the manager said. "They will. You can have both."

item.title: High School Team Wins State Programming Contest
item.description:
Three seniors from Orchard Valley High took first place at the state programming contest on Saturday, solving five of the six problems in the time allowed.

The team's winning entries:

  • a program to schedule the school's bus routes
  • a word puzzle solver
  • a simulation of traffic at the fairgrounds

The team will go on to the regional contest in the spring.

item.title: Clear Skies Forecast for the Harvest Fair
item.description: Clear and cool through the weekend, with highs in the low sixties. Frost is likely in the low-lying orchards on Saturday night.

item.title: Letters: In Praise of the 80-Column Card
item.description:
To the editor:
Since we added an 80-column card, my wife writes her newsletter on the computer, and I have not had to retype a page since.
A satisfied reader, Elm Street.

item.title: Valley Bulletin Board Adds a Second Phone Line
item.description: The valley's computer bulletin board now answers on two lines, so callers should find a busy signal less often in the evenings.

item.title: Library to Lend Educational Software
item.description: Starting next month, cardholders may borrow educational programs for one week at a time, the same as books.

item.title: Recipe Corner: Apple Crisp for a Crowd
item.description: With the harvest in, here is a crisp that serves twenty. Slice twelve apples, toss with sugar and cinnamon, and top with oats, flour and butter. Bake for forty minutes.
